title: Oracle departure step
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $f$ be a tape content function from integers to optional Boolean symbols, and let $p$ be an integer. For either Boolean values $side$ and $verdict$, any valid input-head position for $x$, and any output word, one step from the configuration in departure phase with bookmark $p$ and the head on the first tape at $p$ yields the configuration in the corresponding return phase, with that head at $p+1$ when $side$ is true and at $p-1$ when $side$ is false; the input-head position and output word are preserved.
hypotheses_covered: integer-indexed optional Boolean tape content f
